The moment school management types the text into the cell, that text takes over and this file is ignored for that column. Delete a grade's entry once its cell is filled.
_source: The school's own Trip Explorer prototype text, with safety point 1 corrected to match the wording on the current Safety Guidelines poster (1:8, one adult per 8-9 students). Points 2-11 have NOT been re-checked against the current poster.
_confirm: Management must confirm this is current for 2026-27. Any correction belongs in the sheet, not here.

safety: A ratio of 1:8 is maintained (one accompanying adult for every 8-9 students), including teachers, admin, support staff and Safety Monitors.
Room allocation lets teachers easily monitor students; students know which room their teacher is in.
One adult accompanies students at all times, including washroom breaks and activities.
A student orientation is held 15 days before the trip covering safety protocols.
A trained medical person and first-aid facility are available at the campsite at all times.
Nearest Police Station and Hospital details are kept handy with the Safety Monitor.
Accompanying staff receive first-aid training and carry contact details of all parents.
Staff and vendors are trained under POCSO, with signed undertakings from all vendors.
Each batch has 2 dedicated Safety Monitors focused solely on student safety.
Regular WhatsApp updates with photos/videos are shared with parents.
Headcount is taken at every stop and at regular intervals; health checks are done daily at end of day.
dos: If your child takes any medicine regularly, hand it to the Safety Monitor a day prior at the bus stop, with clear instructions.
Inform the accompanying teacher if your child has any medical history needing personal attention.
donts: Students may not carry personal medicines — staff carry a first-aid box with basics if needed.
Students may not carry mobile phones, smart watches, or other gadgets; these will be confiscated if found.
carry: Clothes for 7 days — full pants, full-sleeve T-shirts, sweatshirts
Water bottle + shoulder bag to carry it throughout the day
Towel, napkin, cap/hat, bandana, cotton socks, warm gloves
Toiletries, moisturizer, sun cream, lip balm
